notes: Added missing schema, API contract, integration, and test coverage stories for explainability layer.

stories.title: Explainability Schema Definition
stories.description: Define a standardized explainability schema (source, meaning, limitations) as Pydantic models to be used across provider and clinical trial evaluation signals.

stories.title: Explainability Aggregation Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to attach explainability metadata to each evaluation signal by deriving source, interpreting meaning, and defining limitations for provider and clinical trial data.

stories.title: Facade API Contract Extension
stories.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade responses to include the explainability schema for all evaluation outputs, ensuring consistent structure returned to the frontend.

stories.title: Explainability Integration with Upstream Signals
stories.description: Integrate explainability layer with outputs from provider credential verification, external links, and clinical trial signals to ensure all upstream data is annotated consistently.

stories.title: Explainability Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating schema compliance, presence of explainability fields, fallback behavior, and correct propagation through the facade API.
